calls.title: Chris Newton and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting was centered around the need to clean and convert leads into marketing contacts, as only 7,000 out of 50,000-60,000 leads had been converted. A significant number of new contacts (3,600) have been sourced from the Rio integration, but leads from other platforms like Mongo and Stripe also require conversion. The team discussed HubSpot's 7,000 marketing contact limit, which poses challenges for email marketing, and they planned to monitor and possibly upgrade the system as needed. A new segmentation strategy was proposed to exclude paying customers from marketing emails to reduce overlap, while a more refined lead scoring model was developed, with designated roles for implementation. Additionally, integration challenges with syncing data across platforms like Customer IO and LinkedIn were acknowledged, calling for resolution to improve operational efficiency.
calls.keywords: Lead Scoring, Marketing Contacts, HubSpot Integration, Rio Data, Customer IO, Email List Cleanup
calls.action_items:
**Chris Newton**
Document the cleanup and conversion process for Rio-sourced contacts and ensure marketing contacts are correctly assigned in HubSpot (16:18)
Create and share segments for paying and free customers for marketing exclusion/inclusion purposes with Karen (31:05)
Lead the alignment and finalization of the lead scoring model; communicate requirements clearly to Roman for implementation and dashboard creation (25:27)
Update the dashboard setup documentation and delete outdated or confusing spreadsheets/files to maintain clarity (27:20)
Explore automation for email sequences and integrations if time permits to improve workflow efficiency (29:31)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Coordinate with Graham to clarify processes for signups and marketing email flows, particularly regarding Rio data and Customer IO integration (11:02)
Support oversight and prioritization of lead scoring and dashboard tasks with Chris and Roman (25:40)
Verify and test HubSpot customer data segments, especially regarding free users and recent Stripe signups (24:26)
Evaluate and consider canceling problematic LinkedIn event integrations, following up on discussions with Karen (31:44)

**Roman**
Clean up the email list by converting Rio sourced contacts and other identified segments into marketing contacts within HubSpot (16:00)
Build the dashboard to display contact and company leads per the finalized lead scoring after coordination with Chris (26:58)

**Karen**
Continue to refine email campaign deliverability and suppression logic in Customer IO to improve performance and reduce duplication with HubSpot communications (22:40)
Assist in discussions and troubleshooting with Roman regarding LinkedIn event integration and unsubscribe syncing issues (31:58)
